modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_shift_forward
modes.plus: base moves forward over planted feet (feet move back relative to base)
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_shift_left
modes.plus: base moves left (feet move right relative to base)
modes.kept_by: only mode driving LF_roll, LF_wrist_roll, RF_roll, RF_wrist_roll

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along roll

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: base yaws left over planted feet (left foot moves back, right foot forward relative to base)

modes.name: trunk_pitch_up
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: lh_arm_forward
modes.plus: left arm reaches forward and down
modes.minus: left arm lifts up and back
modes.kept_by: only mode driving LH_bend, LH_extend, LH_wrist_pitch

modes.name: lh_arm_left
modes.kept_by: only mode driving LH_roll, LH_wrist_roll, LH_wrist_yaw, LH_yaw

modes.name: rh_arm_forward
modes.plus: right arm reaches forward and down
modes.minus: right arm lifts up and back
modes.kept_by: only mode driving RH_bend, RH_extend, RH_wrist_pitch

modes.name: rh_arm_right
modes.kept_by: only mode driving RH_roll, RH_wrist_roll, RH_wrist_yaw, RH_yaw

modes.name: tail_left
modes.kept_by: only mode driving tail_yaw_0, tail_yaw_1, tail_yaw_2, tail_yaw_3, tail_yaw_4, tail_yaw_5, tail_yaw_6

modes.name: tail_forward
modes.kept_by: only mode driving TAIL_close_-1, TAIL_close_1, tail_pitch_0, tail_pitch_1, tail_pitch_2, tail_pitch_3, tail_pitch_4, tail_pitch_5, tail_pitch_6

modes.name: lf_foot_up
modes.plus: left front foot lifts and swings forward
modes.minus: left front foot lifts and swings back

modes.name: rf_foot_up
modes.plus: right front foot lifts and swings forward
modes.minus: right front foot lifts and swings back
